issue.title: GPU-enabled CI tests for Bevy

labels.name: A-Rendering
labels.description: Drawing game state to the screen

labels.name: A-Build-System
labels.description: Related to build systems or continuous integration

repository.name: bevy
repository.description: A refreshingly simple data-driven game engine built in Rust

issue.body:
## What problem does this solve or what need does it fill?

As we work on the renderer, we have no way to detect GPU-only failures in changes made to Bevy.

## What solution would you like?

We also run our CI with a GPU.

## What alternative(s) have you considered?

Authors manually run the GPU examples just before merging in GPU-related code.

CPU-simulated GPUs are apparently another choice.

## Additional context

This [wgpu](https://github.com/gfx-rs/wgpu/pull/968) CI looks like interesting prior art. See #1706 for a particularly nasty example of this failure mode.
